title: Metric Invariants Candidate
purpose: Define the invariant structural properties preserved across admissible context-preserving transformations of the emergent metric structure candidate without introducing numerical metrics or external geometric assumptions.
summary: This patch establishes the first invariant layer of the RT Calculus metric bridge. Invariants describe structural properties preserved under lawful Delta evaluation, ordinal transition, boundary dynamics, and emergent metric organization.

basis.scope: Provisional invariant-candidate witness that extends EMS_Δ into a governed preservation layer while leaving RT_core unchanged and keeping quantitative metric construction deferred.

core_rule.statement: Inv_M may be introduced only downstream of an admitted EMS_Δ candidate, and only as a provisional structural preservation relation that remains distinct from equality, a scalar metric, metric space, topology, manifold, or physical conservation law.

MetricInvariantCandidate.definition: A structural property preserved across admissible context-preserving transformations of EMS_Δ.

InvariantTransformation.definition: A governed transformation preserving declared evaluation context, ordinal ordering, admissibility trace, and RT consistency.

InvariantSet.definition: The set of all admitted metric invariant candidates for a declared EMS_Δ.

candidate_invariants.name: Boundary Classification Preservation
candidate_invariants.statement: Boundary identities remain invariant under admissible transformation.

formal_reading.definition: Inv_M(EMS_Δ,T_inv) := preserved structural relation under admissible T_inv.
formal_reading.important_note: Invariants preserve organization, not numerical value.

governance_rules.rule: Only context-preserving admissible transformations may be tested for invariance.
Invariant comparison never introduces scalar magnitude.
Invariant comparison never assumes Euclidean geometry.
Invariant comparison never introduces topology or differentiability.
Loss of declared evaluation context invalidates invariant comparison.

forbidden_inferences: Invariant does not imply scalar metric.
Invariant does not imply coordinate system.
Invariant does not imply physical conservation law.
Invariant does not imply empirical measurement.

required_repo_changes.description: Add the invariant-candidate witness that introduces Inv_M as a provisional structural preservation relation for EMS_Δ.
Add the trace schema that records context-typed transformations and invariant-preservation checks.
Add the counterexample that blocks equality, metric, topology, and empirical-conservation readings of Inv_M.
Register the new documentation surfaces by hash for governance visibility.
Add the proposed-registration ledger record for the 059 execution-surface update.

textbook_integration.recommended_location: Immediately after Emergent Metric Structure Candidate.

governance_notes: This patch completes the qualitative metric architecture.
